newsitem.title: USA: Conversion Tech names Beck chairman.
newsitem.headline: Conversion Tech names Beck chairman.

text.p: Conversion Technologies International Inc said on Wednesday Eckardt Beck has been appointed chairman.
Beck was previously chairman and chief executive officer of Air & Water Technologies Corp, Conversion said.
Conversion also said William Amt, currently the president and chief executive officer of Octagon Inc, will adopt those titles after Conversion acquires Octagon.
The previous president, chairman and chief executive officer of Conversion was Harvey Goldman, a spokesman said.
Conversion Technologies also said that it has extended its merger agreement with Octagon until June 30, 1997.
The company expects the transaction to close in May 1997, it said.
